description: This Java class 'EntityListIterator' provides an iterator for traversing database query results represented as a ResultSet. It supports navigating through, retrieving, and processing cursored database results for GenericValue entities within the OFBiz framework, managing database resources, and offering utility methods for partial list retrieval and size estimation.

classes.name: EntityListIterator
classes.description: A Java iterator class for iterating over cursor-based database query results within the OFBiz framework. Supports navigation, result retrieval, and resource management, implementing AutoCloseable and ListIterator<GenericValue> interfaces.
